operation.description: Shows whether Dependabot security updates are enabled, disabled or paused for a repository. The authenticated user must have admin read access to the repository. For more information, see "[Configuring Dependabot security updates](https://docs.github.com/articles/configuring-automated-security-fixes)".

404.description: Not Found if Dependabot is not enabled for the repository

operation.summary: Check if Dependabot security updates are enabled for a repository

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

enabled.description: Whether Dependabot security updates are enabled for the repository.

paused.description: Whether Dependabot security updates are paused for the repository.
